thread:
marta: FYI opened a PR touching glossary + several SDK examples. Found inconsistent naming between product UI and SDK. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482

laura: docs-bot: PR created by marta -> modified: /docs/guides/glossary.md, /sdk/python/usage.md, /sdk/js/README.md

docs-bot: automated check -> broken link in /sdk/js/README.md line 42 (404). please fix before merge.

kevin: Quick context: SDK historically used `model_revision` because the runtime internal field is `model_revision`. Product UI shows "model version". We should agree on user-facing term.

sahil: I prefer "model version" for docs and examples. clearer for non-ML folks and matches UI.

marta: Options: 1) Canonicalize docs to "model version" and add migration note; 2) Keep docs as-is but add explicit mapping table explaining internal vs user terms.

kevin: We can avoid a breaking API change: keep the response field name as-is but teach users to call it "model version" in docs, and add SDK aliasing so both names work. Deprecate old name later.

marta: Proposed action plan:
- Update glossary entry to prefer "model version" and call out `model_revision` as internal/legacy.
- Add migration snippet in SDK docs showing both forms and how to alias.
- Implement param aliasing in Python + JS SDKs with deprecation warning.
- Fix the broken link docs-bot flagged.
- Add a one-liner for release notes so GTM teams know wording changed.

laura: Draft glossary blurb suggestion: "model version: the user-facing label for a specific model snapshot used for inference. Historically referenced internally as `model_revision`. See migration notes."

kevin: I'll submit a tiny SDK PR that accepts both `model_revision` and `model_version` / modelVersion. Example snippets I'll add:```python
# preferred
client.generate(model_version=\"redwood-1\", prompt=\"hi\")
# backward-compatible alias (emits DeprecationWarning)
client.generate(model_revision=\"redwood-1\", prompt=\"hi\")
```
and JS:```js
client.generate({ modelVersion: 'redwood-1', prompt: 'hi' })
// also accepts modelRevision with console.warn
```

marta: Sounds good. I'll make the glossary PR and the small migration guide section that includes the snippet and an explanation of why names differ. I'll also fix the broken 404 link in /sdk/js/README.md.

sahil: Please add a CHANGELOG/release-note blurb. Sales copies docs into decks a lot.

marta: Will add a one-line note in the release notes and ping growth.

kevin: ETA: SDK alias PR by EOD tomorrow. I'll include unit tests that call client.generate with both names and assert same behavior / same telemetry tag.

docs-bot: reminder: all SDK PRs require a CHANGELOG entry and a passing linter.

marta: Action list (assignments):
- @laura: final glossary copy + push PR (assigned)
- @kevin: SDK alias PR + tests (in progress)
- @marta: docs PR for migration + fix link (todo)
- @sahil: release-note blurb (todo)

laura: I'll also add a short redirect note in the JS README where `modelRevision` appears, linking to the glossary migration section.

kevin: One tiny ask: can we include a small note in the API reference that responses still contain `model_revision` but clients should treat it as "model version"? I'll add that to the SDK PR and mention it in the docs change.

sahil: Good plan. If anyone hits blockers—call it out here and we can escalate. :thumbsup:

marta: Thanks. I'll post PR numbers when they exist. Closing loop for now.
